en-US.description: A unified communication software suite for BroadWorks phone system
en-US.longDescription:
Go Integrator is a powerful unified communication software suite, which allows users a high level of integration, communication and collaboration with their BroadWorks phone system. Go Integrator allows end users to work more collaboratively and collectively, getting information about callers quickly and efficiently. The Go Integrator product suite is not only cost effective but also very easy to maintain and install.
Go Integrator Cara is the next generation unified communicator and CRM integrator, currently the desktop client that is available to new and existing customers.
en-US.name: Integrator

zh-CN.description: 适用于 BroadWorks 电话系统的统一通信软件套件
zh-CN.longDescription:
Go Integrator 是一款强大统一的通信软件套件，让用户与 BroadWorks 电话系统高度集成、通信与协作。该产品帮助终端用户更高效地协同工作，快速获取来电者信息。Go Integrator 产品套件不仅具有成本效益，而且维护和安装极为简便。
Go Integrator Cara 是新一代统一通信与 CRM 集成工具，目前作为桌面客户端向新老客户开放使用。
